description: Fetch and parse a site's robots.txt per RFC 9309, then report which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, and more) are allowed or blocked for a given path. Also lists sitemaps.

path.description: Path to evaluate access for. Defaults to /

url.description: Website URL. Scheme is optional, example.com works.

name: check_robots_txt
title: Check AI crawler access in robots.txt
